mapper.select:
SELECT ki.id, ki.name, ki.enable, ki.remark, ki.type, ki.cal_type calType, ki.cal_expression calExpression, ki.create_time createTime, CONCAT( '[', GROUP_CONCAT( '[', #{pNetworkId}, SUBSTRING_INDEX(sn.ancestors, #{pNetworkId}, -1), ',', kin.network_id, ']' ), ']' ) networkIdArrayStr, su.nick_name createUserName FROM kpi_indicator ki LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = ki.create_user_id LEFT JOIN kpi_indicator_network kin on kin.indicator_id = ki.id LEFT JOIN sys_network sn ON sn.network_id = kin.network_id WHERE ki.parent_id IS NULL AND ki.del_flag = 0
AND ( ( kin.network_id like concat(',' , #{id} ,','); ) OR ki.create_user_id = #{currentUserId})
AND ki.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT parent_id FROM kpi_indicator ki LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = ki.create_user_id WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL
AND ki.name LIKE concat ( '%', #{indicatorName}, '%' )
AND (su.nick_name LIKE concat ( '%', #{createUserName}, '%' ) OR su.job_number LIKE concat ( '%', #{createUserName}, '%' ))
)
GROUP BY ki.id
